payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all pairs of submission times (i, j) and check if any sum equals x; also handle one-problem or zero-problem cases with direct math.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all possible submission times using nested loops, effectively performing a complete search akin to backtracking over a small finite domain. Other subtypes (bitmask, permutation, graph, branch-and-bound) do not match.
